notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY is out now!
notes.notes:
The game is now available on Steam, and we’re working on making it available on other digital storefronts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1414250/CORPSE_FACTORY/

Working on CORPSE FACTORY has been a truly remarkable experience. The development team is thankful for your ongoing support!

We couldn’t have brought this project to life without you. From the bottom of our hearts, we want to offer our sincerest thanks!

notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY is coming soon - listen to Emi Evans performing the OP!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Fpkrhk6MeWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Emi Evans has lent her extraordinary vocal and lyrical talents to CORPSE FACTORY! Emi is well known for her work on a multitude of game soundtracks, including Nier: Automata, Dark Souls and Granblue Fantasy. In addition to game music, she has even performed on Star Wars: Visions!

Composed by Alec Shea, and with lyrics written and performed by Emi Evans, ‘Strange Flower’ will serve as the opening theme for CORPSE FACTORY. It’s a dark, hauntingly beautiful track that truly emcompasses the motifs of the game.

You can wishlist CORPSE FACTORY on Steam today!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1414250/CORPSE_FACTORY/]CORPSE FACTORY on Steam[/url]


‘Strange Flower’ credits:

Composed by Alec Shea
Lyrics/Vocals - Emi Evans
Piano - Rob Kovacs
Cello - Mason Lieberman
Mix Engineer - Masahiro Aoki
Score Engraving Assistance - Thomas Misson
Emi Evans is represented by Scarlet Moon Productions

CORPSE FACTORY for Nintendo Switch & PC is now live on Kickstarter!

This is a great opportunity to get in on the ground floor and secure a copy of the game for your platform of choice. By supporting us on Kickstarter, you can score your name in the game's credits and help bring it to life.

notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY Kickstarter Re-launching on June 1st!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that CORPSE FACTORY will re-launch on Kickstarter on June 1st.

We've made some little adjustments to the campaign to help it run smoothly this time around. Additionally, some new physical goodies have been included as add-ons, such as tarot cards and art prints.

Be sure to hit the link below and click 'Notify me on launch' so you don't miss out!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sleepyduck/corpse-factory-thriller-visual-novel-nintendo-switch-and-pc-0

The Kickstarter will go live at approximately the following time:

June 1st, 22:00 UTC.

For folks in the USA, that's about 3pm on the west coast and 6pm on the east coast.

For our friends down under, and for some people in Europe, the launch date may fall on June 2nd.

Thank you for all of your support so far. Let's bring CORPSE FACTORY to life!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.notes:
We're very happy to announce [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] are now available for [i][b]How To Date A Magical Girl![/b][/i]

There are 12 cards to collect, and you can earn these simply by playing the game. In addition, by collecting cards and upgrading your badges, you can earn 5 unique backgrounds and 5 emotes!
